Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
rogc...@student.luth.se (Roger Carhult) wrote:
>1) I can't Far Master a retainer on an ally (by card text) right?

Right. You'd need an ally that could play cards that require dominate
as a vampire.

>2) Can I do Far Mastery on a vampire I control to transfer the
>retainer to another minion?

To the acting minion, yes.

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
LSJ <vte...@mailandnews.com> wrote:
> rogc...@student.luth.se (Roger Carhult) wrote:
>>1) I can't Far Master a retainer on an ally (by card text) right?

> Right. You'd need an ally that could play cards that require dominate
> as a vampire.

That wasn't his question.
He was asking about if the acting minion was a vampire, and the target
minion was an ally. By card text, it says that you can take a retainer
from a vampire, not from a minion.
